messages:
vivian: Heads-up — AcmeHealth reported intermittent 503s from their dedicated pool during the 22:00 UTC high-traffic burst. CS flagged this as a P1 SLA risk and wants an engineering mitigation plan now.

sam: Looking at metrics now. Pool GPU utilization hitting 98% and autoscaler logs show repeated 'quota_exceeded' from cloud-provider. Might be scaling blocked, not runtime.

maria (CS): Impact window started ~2026-03-17T22:05Z. Customer says if errors persist for >15m they'll hit breach. They requested a temporary fallback to hosted models while we triage.

kai (oncall): I can flip customer-level routing to hosted fallback for the next 30m to buy time. Need a safe toggle path and one reviewer for the infra-control PR. Anyone available to review and approve quickly?

lina (infra): I'm out of immediate capacity to patch autoscaler, but can approve a config-only change. Which PR?

sam: PR is #7891 — adds a customer fallback toggle and a short-circuit for the autoscale quota check. Link: https://git.redwood/pr/7891. Small change but needs a unit test and a canary rollout plan.

vivian: @kai please proceed with fallback if you can. @lina can you review config toggle? I'll notify customer of 30m fallback and ETA for permanent fix.

lina (infra): Skimming PR now. Test coverage looks ok but add a guard for missing customer routing entry. Will approve in 10m if added.

kai (oncall): I'll trigger the toggle via infra-control REST endpoint once PR is merged. Command I'll run:```
curl -X POST https://infra-control.internal/api/v1/customers/fallback 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $INFRATOKEN' 
  -d '{"customer_id":"acmehealth","enable":true,"ttl_seconds":1800}'
```

incidents-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0317-ACME (priority: P1) — bridge: #incident-acmehealth.

sam: Lina added the guard, pushed change, unit tests pass on CI. Assigning review to vivian for config semantics.

vivian: Approved. :thumbsup: Sam, please merge and kick the canary. Kai, stand by to flip toggle after deploy-bot confirms.

deploy-bot: deploy started — infra-control @main via CI pipeline (pr-7891) — canary 1/3 nodes.

kai (oncall): Confirming I'll watch logs and revert fallback if we see adverse effects. I'll also open a follow-up ticket to track quota increase or autoscaler fix.

sam: Canary looks healthy so far, no 503s in canary region. Rolling to remainder.

incidents-bot: INC-2026-0317-ACME updated: mitigation in place (routing fallback enabled). SLA breach risk reduced.

maria (CS): Customer notified and appreciates quick response. They're OK with hosted fallback for 30m while you patch autoscaler.

vivian: Next steps: (1) sam/lina pair to root-cause autoscaler quota error (owner: lina) with ETA 24h, (2) sam to PR autoscale fix + tests, (3) kai to monitor and escalate if errors reappear. I'm capturing action items in the incident ticket.

sam: I'll open a tracking PR for autoscaler fix shortly and post link here.

vivian: Thanks team — great cross-team hustle. Will close thread once incident ticket has next-steps and owners confirmed. :rocket:
